_doc: BACKLOG §M phase 3: the heuristic agents' answer to a SkillUse offer, read VERBATIM by both engines (Rust SkillPolicy, Java SkillPolicy; the CLI exports FFB_SKILL_POLICY). use = weight of USING the skill when offered, in thousandths (softmax T=0.20 over use vs 1000-use). coverage = how strongly --coverage-bias B pulls it toward use: w + (B*coverage/1000)*(1-w). Keys are SkillId / Java class simple names. DumpOff with no in-range receiver is pinned to 0 in code in both agents.
